buildingCutout.basis: The heritage building’s contemporary mapped perimeter.

identities.name: Kaohsiung Museum of History
identities.address: No. 272, Zhongzheng 4th Road, Yancheng District, Kaohsiung, Taiwan

mapIdentity.scope: Mapped named way 203122000 and Wikidata Q6125749 identify the building independently. The south and east fronts are supported by two archive views. The model follows the actual building center near the former city hall rather than the story’s broader location.

note: The national heritage inventory dates the former city hall to 1939. The National Museum of Taiwan History records a four-level center, a pale green and ivory finish, and three pavilions over the otherwise Western-style two-storey civic façade.
